claims.object_text: potentiation of NMDAR-mediated currents and attenuation of synaptic density deficits in heterologous cell systems
claims.quote: In heterologous cell systems, administration of spermine potentiated wild-type and loss-of-function (LoF) NMDAR-mediated currents and attenuated synaptic density deficits.

claims.object_text: spermidine administration partially rescued hippocampal long-term potentiation deficits in Grin2b+/- mice
claims.quote: Chronic spermidine administration in young adult Grin2b+/- mice partially rescued hippocampal long-term potentiation deficits in hippocampal slices of Grin2b+/- mice, supporting the cognitive improvement observed in behavioral phenotyping.
